newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian shares rise on results.
newsitem.headline: Latvian shares rise on results.

text.p: Latvian shares gained in light trade on Thursday as the market responded to a spate of promising interim results, dealers said.
Overall market volume was 66,000 lats and the Rietumu index rose 2.05 percent to 155.25. The bourse index rose 2.02 percent to 396.05.
Riga Transport Fleet led the way as it climbed sharply to 1.43 lats from 1.27 in trade of 14,300 lats.
"Transport Fleet is up because of its half-year results," said one dealer.
Latvian Bridges, which announced on Wednesday that its interim profit was 84,000 lats, also leapt, rising to 1.18 lats from 1.05 in trade of 2,000 lats.
Unibanka extended its recent gains, rising to 3.39 lats from 3.36 on turnover of 17,700 lats.
One million of the state's shares in the bank were auctioned on Monday at what dealers said was a bargain price of 3.22 lats.
It is expected to gain further to around 3.50 lats before stabilising.
